about: Statistics of the workspace demo DataGen (worker group, in_gigamon_datagen), derived by scripts/derive-demo-profile.mjs. Field names, arrival types, presence rates, quantiles of sizes and timings, and the distributions of an allowlist of Gigamon enumerations only: no address, name, identifier or free-text value of the source is recorded here.
notes: `_time` is on every source event (the DataGen template stamps it); the pack's samples omit it and Cribl adds it on replay.
